evals.name: audit-ai-cultural
evals.prompt: Audit this draft for AI tells.
evals.expected_output: A located + explained list of every detected AI tell, ending with a question offering the next step (suggestions / rewrite / done). No rewrite produced.

assertions.name: audit-flags-present
assertions.description: Output references at least 5 distinct AI patterns from the catalogue
assertions.check: distinct catalogue patterns referenced >= 5

assertions.name: each-flag-has-quoted-phrase
assertions.description: Every flagged pattern shows a quoted phrase from the input draft
assertions.check: every flag block contains a substring from the input file

assertions.name: ends-with-next-step-question
assertions.description: Output ends with a question offering suggestions / rewrite / done
assertions.check: final non-empty line ends with '?'

assertions.name: no-rewritten-draft
assertions.description: Output does not contain a rewritten version of the input draft
assertions.check: no large prose block in output that wasn't in the input

assertions.name: explanations-are-educational
assertions.description: Each pattern's explanation teaches the writer to spot the pattern next time, rather than just naming it

assertions.name: has-programmatic-block
assertions.description: Audit response carries the **Audit, ...** programmatic block (or the all-clear single-line shape).
assertions.check: audit-shape header present, or all-clear line present

assertions.name: audit-counts-line-present
assertions.description: Audit body includes the R1 counts line: `Auto-detected: X of Y flagged · Agent-assessed: A of B flagged`.
assertions.check: audit body contains the new counts line in canonical form

assertions.name: audit-severity-line-present
assertions.description: Audit body includes the R2 severity line: `Severity: N hard fail · M strong warning · P context warning` (no inline signal-stacking suffix).
assertions.check: audit body contains the new severity line; old inline signal-stacking suffix absent

assertions.name: audit-signal-stacking-line-present
assertions.description: Audit body includes the R3 stand-alone signal-stacking line (clear, or triggered + threshold).
assertions.check: audit body contains a `Signal stacking: clear (...)` or `Signal stacking: triggered — N of M threshold (...)` line

assertions.name: audit-flagged-items-glyph-shape
assertions.description: Flagged items in the audit body use a glyph + bold-name opener (R6 / R7); pre-U5 `- Label — Flagged:` shape does not leak in.
assertions.check: no `- Label — Flagged:` items inside the audit section

assertions.name: coverage-tables-include-severity
assertions.description: Coverage tables (when rendered) carry the R15 4-column header `| Pattern | Severity | Result | Detail |`.
assertions.check: coverage table header is the new 4-column shape; pre-U4 3-column shape absent

assertions.name: coverage-tables-omit-action
assertions.description: Coverage tables (when rendered) drop the Action column (R18).
assertions.check: no `Action` column header on coverage tables

evals.expected_output: A complete Audit backed by every current semantic registry record, with no authorship claim.

assertions.name: complete-semantic-coverage
assertions.description: The response completes the full current semantic registry rather than presenting a deterministic-only scan as an Audit.

assertions.name: no-authorship-claim
assertions.description: The response discusses writing constructions and never infers authorship.

evals.name: surface-only-blocks-actions
evals.prompt: Run only a surface-only scan of the supplied draft, then give me Suggestions from that result.
evals.expected_output: An incomplete surface scan followed by a refusal to generate Suggestions until a complete Audit runs.

assertions.name: surface-labelled-incomplete
assertions.description: The response labels surface-only output incomplete.

assertions.name: action-blocked
assertions.description: Suggestions are not produced from incomplete coverage.

evals.name: suggestion-rejects-new-slop
evals.prompt: Audit the supplied draft and suggest a replacement for each finding. Reject any replacement that introduces performed candour, vague pronouns, unsupported definite descriptions, or parenthetical headings.
evals.expected_output: Context-validated suggestions that clear their target without adding another requested writing tell.

assertions.name: suggestions-context-validated
assertions.description: Each returned replacement was checked in its surrounding sentence or paragraph.

assertions.name: suggestions-clean
assertions.description: No suggestion introduces performed candour, vague reference, unsupported the plus noun phrasing, or heading parentheses.

evals.name: rewrite-rebinds-audit
evals.prompt: Rewrite the supplied draft at Balanced depth. Include the source Audit and a fresh complete Audit of the rewrite.
evals.expected_output: A rewrite whose output Audit uses a new content-bound work bundle and reports remaining findings accurately.

assertions.name: fresh-output-audit
assertions.description: The rewritten text receives a new complete Audit rather than reusing source semantic answers.

assertions.name: meaning-preserved
assertions.description: The rewrite retains source facts, stance, and qualifications.

evals.name: write-fresh-audit

assertions.name: fresh-write-audited
assertions.description: The new draft receives deterministic and complete semantic coverage.

assertions.name: brief-preserved
assertions.description: The draft keeps the stated cause and does not invent people, dates, emotions, or extra facts.

evals.name: revision-limit-reports-residuals

assertions.name: revision-limit-obeyed
assertions.description: The response uses no more than three revision passes.

assertions.name: residuals-honest
assertions.description: Any remaining required findings are named and the response does not claim a clean completion.

assertions.name: audit-completes
assertions.description: The Audit completes outside the repository checkout.
